note: The two sets are nearly identical in content, quotes, and conditions, including the same duplicated claims (pitch start wind speed, 0° pitch setting, minimum and rated rotational speed). The only differences are the two wind-region claims: A frames them as 'operation mode' (rated power / optimal TSR) with the wind-speed range as condition, while B frames them as 'operating range' with the mode as condition; both are supported by the same region headings and neither misbinds values. No claims in either set are misread or invented, and both omit the same facts (e.g., DTU pole frequencies, ROSCO estimator).
